ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising edge used by all clocked processes; sequences resets and captures into registers such as ctrl, rtx_engine and status outputs. It times the bus access, transceiver, irq and clock generator processes.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) used in processes bus_access, transceiver, irq_generator, chip_select, clock_generator

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Active-low reset that forces initialization values in reset branches; clears registers and outputs at reset across bus_access, transceiver, irq, chip_select and clock_generator processes.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then ... in multiple processes (bus_access, transceiver, irq_generator, chip_select, clock_generator)

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Bundle carrying bus transaction fields; individual fields are used by the design but the aggregate record is not referenced as a whole in expressions inside this source.
ports.evidence: only individual fields (bus_req_i.stb, .rw, .addr, .data) are referenced in processes; aggregate never appears as RHS

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.function: bus address bit used to select registers/FIFO
ports.functionality: Bit 2 of the bus address gates whether accesses target control registers or FIFOs; it governs assignments and read-data selection in the bus access process and conditions FIFO write/read enables.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '0') then ... else ... in bus_access; used in tx_fifo.we and rx_fifo.re concurrent expressions

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Supplies bits used to write the control register fields and to form the transmit FIFO write word; its slices are captured into ctrl fields and concatenated into tx_fifo.wdata on writes.

relationship.bits: prsc: ctrl_prsc2_c downto ctrl_prsc0_c; cdiv: ctrl_cdiv3_c downto ctrl_cdiv0_c; tx_fifo.wdata: bit 8 from data(31), bits 7 downto 0 from data(7 downto 0)

ports.evidence: Assignments in bus_access: ctrl.* <= bus_req_i.data(...); tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.data(31) & bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0)

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Declared bus byte-enable field but not referenced in this source; no behaviour in this entity's code.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of bus_req_i.ben in source

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Indicates an active bus transaction; is sampled to drive bus response ack and gates read/write handling and FIFO enables.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb; many 'if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') then' conditions; used in tx_fifo.we and rx_fifo.re expressions

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Selects write vs read paths in the bus access process and participates in FIFO write/read enable conditions.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.rw = '1') then ... else ... in bus_access; used in tx_fifo.we and rx_fifo.re conditions

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Declared field of bus_req_t but not referenced in this source.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of bus_req_i.src in source

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Declared but not used inside this entity's source.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of bus_req_i.priv in source

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced in the implementation shown.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of bus_req_i.debug in source

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Declared but unused in this source.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of bus_req_i.amo in source

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced here.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of bus_req_i.amoop in source

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Declared but unused in this entity.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of bus_req_i.lock in source

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Declared in the bus request type but not used in this source.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of bus_req_i.fence in source

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Bundle exporting bus response signals (ack, err, data) driven from internal state and status; the aggregate is produced by the bus_access logic and presented to the outside bus.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o fields assigned in bus_access process and driven to the external bus

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Captures bus_req_i.stb on the rising clock to produce an ack back to the requester; acknowleges the transaction sampled from bus_req_i.stb.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb inside rising_edge(clk_i) in bus_access

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Reports error status; in this implementation it is driven to constant '0' on each clock, so it captures a literal value.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.err <= '0' inside rising_edge(clk_i) in bus_access (literal assigned)

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Holds readback data and status bits presented on the bus; different bits are captured from ctrl fields, FIFO status and rx_fifo.rdata depending on the addressed register.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data(...) <= ctrl.* and rx_fifo.rdata and tx_fifo status assignments inside rising_edge(clk_i) in bus_access

ports.name: clkgen_en_o
ports.functionality: Directly reflects the internal control enable to an output; driven combinationally from ctrl.enable.
ports.evidence: clkgen_en_o <= ctrl.enable; concurrent assignment at end of architecture

ports.name: clkgen_i
ports.functionality: Vector of clock prescaler inputs indexed by ctrl.prsc to pace the SPI SCLK; a selected bit is sampled to enable the SPI prescaler and gate spi_clk_en.
ports.evidence: clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc))) = '1' used in clock_generator if condition

ports.name: spi_clk_o
ports.functionality: Drives the external SPI clock directly from the transceiver's sck signal; updates concurrently with internal sck.
ports.evidence: spi_clk_o <= rtx_engine.sck; concurrent assignment

ports.name: spi_dat_o
ports.functionality: Outputs the MSB of the transmit shift register to the SPI data output; directly reflects rtx_engine.sreg(7).
ports.evidence: spi_dat_o <= rtx_engine.sreg(7); concurrent assignment

ports.name: spi_dat_i
ports.functionality: External serial data input sampled into the transceiver; is synchronized into rtx_engine.sdi_sync during bit transfers.
ports.evidence: rtx_engine.sdi_sync <= spi_dat_i inside transceiver when state = "110"

ports.name: spi_csn_o
ports.functionality: Drives an active-low chip-select vector based on rtx_engine.cs_ctrl; defaults to all '1's and clears one bit to '0' indexed by cs_ctrl when active.
ports.evidence: spi_csn_o <= (others => '1') and spi_csn_o(to_integer(unsigned(rtx_engine.cs_ctrl(2 downto 0)))) <= '0' when rtx_engine.cs_ctrl(3) = '1' in chip_select process

ports.name: irq_o
ports.functionality: Produces the interrupt signal from enabled IRQ sources and FIFO/engine status; on each clock it is assigned a logical function of ctrl.enable, ctrl.irq_* flags, FIFO status and engine busy state.
ports.evidence: irq_o <= ctrl.enable and ((ctrl.irq_rx_avail and rx_fifo.avail) or ... ) inside rising_edge(clk_i) in irq_generator

signals.name: ctrl
signals.functionality: Holds SPI configuration bits and IRQ enable flags; captured from bus_req_i.data on writes and read back to bus_rsp_o, and used across clocked and concurrent logic to control the transceiver and clock generator.
signals.evidence: ctrl.* <= bus_req_i.data(...) inside rising_edge(clk_i) in bus_access

signals.name: ctrl.enable
signals.functionality: Holds the global SPI enable; captured from bus write, controls FIFO clears, enables the prescaler and is forwarded to clkgen_en_o and rtx_engine.state(2).
signals.evidence: ctrl.enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c) in bus_access; used in clock_generator and assigned to rtx_engine.state(2); tx_fifo.clear <= not ctrl.enable

signals.name: ctrl.cpha
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes and used by the transceiver to determine SCK phase behaviour and bit sampling/toggling logic.
signals.evidence: ctrl.cpha <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_cpha_c) in bus_access; used in transceiver branches to decide sck assignments

signals.name: ctrl.cpol
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes and provides the idle/active polarity for the SPI clock; used to initialize and toggle rtx_engine.sck in the transceiver.
signals.evidence: ctrl.cpol <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_cpol_c) in bus_access; used as RHS for sck assignments in transceiver

signals.name: ctrl.prsc
signals.functionality: Three-bit prescaler index captured from bus writes; used to index clkgen_i to select one prescaler bit for the clock-generator decision.
signals.evidence: ctrl.prsc <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_prsc2_c downto ctrl_prsc0_c); clkgen_i(to_integer(unsigned(ctrl.prsc))) used in clock_generator

signals.name: ctrl.cdiv
signals.functionality: Four-bit divider compare value captured from bus writes; the prescaler counter compares to this value to assert spi_clk_en and reset the counter.
signals.evidence: ctrl.cdiv <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_cdiv3_c downto ctrl_cdiv0_c); compared with cdiv_cnt in clock_generator

signals.name: ctrl.highspeed
signals.functionality: When set, bypasses the selected clkgen_i bit to speed the SPI clock; captured from bus and used in the prescaler enable condition.
signals.evidence: ctrl.highspeed <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_highspeed_c); used in clock_generator condition (.. or ctrl.highspeed = '1')

signals.name: ctrl.irq_rx_avail
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes; when set it contributes to the irq_o expression together with rx_fifo.avail.
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_rx_avail <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_rx_avail_c); used in irq_o assignment

signals.name: ctrl.irq_tx_empty
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes and used together with tx_fifo.avail (negated) to form the irq_o output.
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_tx_empty <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_tx_empty_c); used in irq_o expression

signals.name: ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf
signals.function: IRQ enable for TX nearly half
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes and used with tx_fifo.half (negated) to generate irq_o when configured.
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_tx_nhalf <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_tx_nhalf_c); used in irq_o expression

signals.name: ctrl.irq_idle
signals.functionality: Captured from bus writes; when set, it contributes to irq_o when TX FIFO is empty and the engine is not busy.
signals.evidence: ctrl.irq_idle <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_irq_idle_c); used in irq_o assignment

signals.name: cdiv_cnt
signals.functionality: Counts prescaler cycles when SPI enabled; increments each clock until it equals ctrl.cdiv, then asserts spi_clk_en and resets to zero.
signals.evidence: cdiv_cnt compared with ctrl.cdiv and incremented or reset in clock_generator; spi_clk_en set when equal

signals.name: spi_clk_en
signals.functionality: One-clock pulse asserted when prescaler reaches the compare value or highspeed condition; used by the transceiver to advance SCK and state machine.
signals.evidence: spi_clk_en set inside clock_generator when cdiv_cnt = ctrl.cdiv or ctrl.highspeed; used in transceiver branches (if spi_clk_en = '1')

signals.name: rtx_engine
signals.functionality: Record holding engine state, busy flag, shift register, bit counter, input sync, sck and CS control; updated in the transceiver process and drives SPI signals and FIFO interactions.
signals.evidence: rtx_engine fields assigned and updated inside transceiver process; state(2) <= ctrl.enable, sreg loaded from tx_fifo.rdata

signals.name: rtx_engine.state
signals.functionality: Three-bit state vector driving the transceiver state machine; state(2) follows ctrl.enable and state bits select transceiver actions and FIFO read timing.
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.state(2) <= ctrl.enable; case rtx_engine.state is ... controls behaviour and tx_fifo.re uses state = "100"

signals.name: rtx_engine.busy
signals.functionality: Reflects whether the transceiver is active; computed from state bits and used in IRQ generation and bus status reads.
role: reflected to bus and IRQ logic
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.busy <= '0' when (rtx_engine.state(1 downto 0) = "00") else '1'; used in irq_o and bus_rsp_o.busy readback

signals.name: rtx_engine.sreg
signals.functionality: Eight-bit shift register holding the byte being transmitted/received; loaded from tx_fifo.rdata and shifted with sampled MISO into LSBs, and its MSB is driven on MOSI.
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.sreg <= tx_fifo.rdata(7 downto 0) on load; sreg shifted and assigned to spi_dat_o and rx_fifo.wdata <= '0' & rtx_engine.sreg

signals.name: rtx_engine.bitcnt
signals.functionality: Counts bits shifted during a byte transfer; incremented when spi_clk_en pulses and used to detect transfer completion.
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.bitcnt <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(rtx_engine.bitcnt) + 1) in transceiver when spi_clk_en = '1'

signals.name: rtx_engine.sdi_sync
signals.functionality: Holds the sampled MISO line when captured by the transceiver on the appropriate clock phase; used to shift into sreg.
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.sdi_sync <= spi_dat_i in state "110"; sreg <= sreg(6 downto 0) & sdi_sync in state "111"

signals.name: rtx_engine.sck
signals.functionality: Internal SCK driven by control polarity and phase settings; updated in the transceiver state machine to form the spi_clk_o output.
signals.evidence: Various assignments rtx_engine.sck <= ctrl.cpol / not ctrl.cpol / ctrl.cpha xor ctrl.cpol in transceiver; spi_clk_o <= rtx_engine.sck

signals.name: rtx_engine.cs_ctrl
signals.functionality: Four-bit register carrying CS selection and active flag; when loaded from a control word the high bit indicates selection and lower bits index which CS to assert low.
signals.evidence: If tx_fifo.rdata(8) = '1' then rtx_engine.cs_ctrl <= tx_fifo.rdata(3 downto 0) in transceiver; spi_csn_o is assigned based on rtx_engine.cs_ctrl

signals.name: rtx_engine.done
signals.functionality: One-clock pulse asserted when a byte transfer completes; used to write received data into the rx FIFO.
signals.evidence: rtx_engine.done set to '1' on transfer completion in transceiver; rx_fifo.we <= rtx_engine.done

signals.name: tx_fifo
signals.functionality: Packaged signals used to interface the instantiated FIFO; its fields (we, wdata, re, rdata, avail, free, clear, half) connect to the FIFO instance and surrounding logic.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo is a record connected to neorv32_fifo instance port map and driven/consumed by concurrent statements and instance ports

signals.name: tx_fifo.we
signals.functionality: Concurrent write enable asserted when a bus write targets the TX FIFO (bus_req_i.stb and rw=1 and addr(2)=1).
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.we <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '1') and (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '1') else '0'

signals.name: tx_fifo.re
signals.functionality: Pulsed when the transceiver begins a transfer state (state = "100") to pop a transmit word from the FIFO for loading into the engine.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.re <= '1' when (rtx_engine.state = "100") else '0'

signals.name: tx_fifo.wdata
signals.functionality: Constructed from bus write data: MSB from bus_req_i.data(31) and lower 8 bits from bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0); supplied to FIFO when tx_fifo.we asserted.

relationship.bits: bit 8 <= data(31); bits 7 downto 0 <= data(7 downto 0)

signals.evidence: tx_fifo.wdata <= bus_req_i.data(31) & bus_req_i.data(7 downto 0)

signals.name: tx_fifo.rdata
signals.functionality: Word read from the TX FIFO instance; used by the transceiver to either set CS control (if high bit) or load the transmit shift register.
signals.evidence: In transceiver: if tx_fifo.rdata(8) = '1' then cs_ctrl <= tx_fifo.rdata(3 downto 0) else sreg <= tx_fifo.rdata(7 downto 0)

signals.name: tx_fifo.avail
signals.functionality: Indicates FIFO contains data; used in bus readback status and in irq and busy calculations.
role: used in IRQ and status readback
signals.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_rx_avail_c) <= rx_fifo.avail; bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_tx_empty_c) <= not tx_fifo.avail; used in irq and busy computation

signals.name: tx_fifo.free
signals.functionality: Indicates FIFO has free space; exposed in status reads (inverted) to indicate full condition.
signals.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_tx_full_c) <= not tx_fifo.free in bus_access

signals.name: tx_fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Active clear input for the TX FIFO driven from not ctrl.enable; clears FIFO when SPI is disabled.
signals.evidence: tx_fifo.clear <= not ctrl.enable

signals.name: tx_fifo.half
signals.functionality: Indicates FIFO half-full state and is used negated in bus status and IRQ logic.
signals.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_tx_nhalf_c) <= not tx_fifo.half; used in irq_o expression

signals.name: rx_fifo
signals.functionality: Record connecting instantiated RX FIFO ports and local signals for read/write, data, and status; its fields are set by the engine and read by the bus logic.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo record connected to neorv32_fifo instance port map and used by concurrent statements and instance ports

signals.name: rx_fifo.we
signals.functionality: Asserted when a received byte is done (rtx_engine.done) to push received data into the RX FIFO.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.we <= rtx_engine.done

signals.name: rx_fifo.re
signals.functionality: Driven by bus reads: asserted when bus_req_i.stb and rw=0 and addr(2)=1 to pop data for bus reads.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.re <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.rw = '0') and (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '1') else '0'

signals.name: rx_fifo.wdata
signals.functionality: Formatted received byte written into RX FIFO: MSB is '0' and lower bits are the engine shift register contents; driven when a transfer completes.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.wdata <= '0' & rtx_engine.sreg

signals.name: rx_fifo.rdata
signals.functionality: Data word read from the RX FIFO; when the bus reads the RX FIFO data it is placed on bus_rsp_o.data lower byte.
signals.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data(7 downto 0) <= rx_fifo.rdata(7 downto 0) in bus_access

signals.name: rx_fifo.avail
signals.functionality: Indicates RX FIFO contains data; used in readback status bits and IRQ generation.
signals.evidence: bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_rx_avail_c) <= rx_fifo.avail; used in irq_o expression

signals.name: rx_fifo.free
signals.functionality: Provided by the FIFO instance (not used heavily here); available for status if required.
signals.evidence: free_o port of rx_fifo instance mapped to rx_fifo.free; no other references in this source

signals.name: rx_fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Clear input for RX FIFO driven from not ctrl.enable so the FIFO is cleared when SPI is disabled.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.clear <= not ctrl.enable

signals.name: rx_fifo.half
signals.functionality: Half-full indicator from the FIFO instance; available to status reads but not otherwise used in logic here.
signals.evidence: rx_fifo.half is mapped from FIFO half_o; only rx_fifo.half referenced for completeness in record
